verdict.rationale: Runpod documents Instant Clusters as fully managed multi-node compute with high-performance networking for distributed training, deployable without managing infrastructure/networking/cluster configuration, and explicitly targets training models too large for one GPU or accelerating training across multiple nodes — all self-service via console/API/CLI without a sales process. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on benchmark of actual interconnect performance (e.g., InfiniBand/NVLink specifics or bandwidth numbers) and no community corroboration of successfully running a multi-node cluster end-to-end.
